TANCET Result 2026 Download PDF Link

Anna University has activated the TANCET Result 2026 download link on the official website. Candidates can check and download the result PDF by logging in with the email ID and password. The result includes important details such as candidate name, marks obtained, percentile score and section wise scores. Below we have provided the direct link to download the result.

How to Download TANCET Result 2026?

Candidates can download TANCET Result 2026 online through the official website of Anna University. Candidates need a registered email ID and password to access the result. Candidates can follow the steps to download the results.

  • Visit the official website @tancet.annauniv.edu.in.
  • Click on TANCET 2026 Result Link.
  • Enter Registered Email ID and Password.
  • Check the result displayed on the screen.
  • Click on download to save the PDF.

Details Mentioned in TANCET Result 2026

TANCET Result 2026 contains important information related to the candidates exam performance and personal details. Candidates should carefully check all the details mentioned in the result. The details are as follows.

  • Name of the Candidate

What Next After TANCET Result 2026?

Once the TANCET Result 2026 is out candidates should download and save scorecards for future use. The next step is to wait for the counselling registration and rank list release. Candidates must keep all required documents ready for the admission process. Based on the rank and score candidates will be able to apply for MBA and MCA admissions in participating colleges across Tamil Nadu.

TANCET Result 2026 FAQs

Ans. Anna University has released the the result on 22nd May 2026 on the official website.
